admissionReview.historicalComparisonUniverse: The accepted C56 crosswalk covers all 38 v16 cases and eight older cases from B70. All currently unresolved older cases are in that preserved universe.
admissionReview.sourceDistinctions: Rechecked each retained actual C behavior, relevant state and action history against all v16 cases and the unresolved older cases. Shared command/setup paths do not constitute overlap. No overlapping membership found.
admissionReview.metadataRefinement: The wooden-flute/charm_snakes row’s closest Bell comparison mistakenly described wooden-harp/calm_nymphs. The actual flute route changes snake peaceful/avenging/wait state and produces its reaction after the flute-trill More page; Bell of Opening reaches use_bell/openit. This correction changes no input, hash, membership or independent C replay.
